title: Alonso Sánchez (Venice) to Charles V, May–August 1523 — RAH Salazar 9/28, DECODE R9670–R9770

steps.what: Found the ten records in the DECODE group harvest (Salazar 9/28, author Alonso Sánchez), pulled record pages and metadata; all flagged Inline Cleartext: Yes. Fetched 32 images.

Viewed the images: no interlinear or facing decipherment; 'Inline Cleartext' means clear passages. Same hand and cipher as the 1522 despatches; letters addressed to the Emperor, not an unknown recipient.

Fetched Bergenroth CSP Spain vol. 2 (1523) from British History Online; nos. 549, 552, 554, 558 are these despatches (Salazar A-28, matching folios), each 'Autograph in cipher. Contemporary deciphering.'
Mapped each record to a CSP entry by date line, content and folio; R9670/R9674/R9690/R9770 are duplicates; R9767, R9769, R9770 (16 Aug 1523) are not calendared.
Applied the 1522 key (targets/sanchez1522/key_codes.tsv) to code groups on R9670, R9671, R9672, R9677, R9767: they read coherently; key unchanged into 1523.

Read R9767 (16 Aug 1523): clear text in full; cipher passages at code-group level, spelled runs partly. Gist: French-leaning party in Venice, the treaty's money clause, the Infante not bound to the defensive league.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): linked Bergenroth's CSP abstracts (R9670-R9690) and read_r9767.md; no ciphertext transcriptions; R9769/R9770 not transcribed

outcome.method_basis: The code groups were read with Sánchez's own 1522 key (Tomokiyo, cryptiana AlonsoSanchez.htm 2025, extended in sanchez1522), unchanged into 1523; the May-June despatches were already calendared by Bergenroth (CSP Spain 2, nos. 549-558) from the contemporary decipherings.
outcome.notes: The May–June despatches were deciphered at the time and calendared in English by Bergenroth in 1866; the key was published by Tomokiyo in 2025. Added here: the records identified against the Calendar, the recipient corrected (Charles V), the 1522 key shown to hold in 1523, and a partial reading of the one uncalendared ciphered letter (R9767, 16 Aug 1523). The spelled runs of R9767 and the short cipher of R9770 stay open.

texts.label: R9670, 8 May 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. Doge Grimani's death and Cornaro's illness delay the negotiations with Venice; duplicate of the letter calendared as no. 549.
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 549), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9671, 8 May 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. Doge Grimani's death and Cornaro's illness delay the negotiations with Venice for the alliance of Venice, the Emperor and England (CSP Spain 2 no. 549).
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 549), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9672, c. 20-23 May 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. The election of the new Doge (Gritti); cf. CSP Spain 2 no. 552.
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 552), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9674, 20 May 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. Duplicate ('es treslado de otro') of the letter calendared as CSP Spain 2 no. 552.
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 552), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9677, early June 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. The Infante's powers; probably CSP Spain 2 no. 554 (5 June).
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 554), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9689, 13 June 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. CSP Spain 2 no. 558.
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 558), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9690, 13 June 1523
texts.summary: Alonso Sánchez in Venice to Charles V. CSP Spain 2 no. 558 (second copy).
texts.note: Decryption: only Bergenroth's English abstract (CSP Spain 2, 1866, no. 558), made from the contemporary deciphering filed separately in the volume and not imaged; no transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9767, 16 Aug 1523
texts.summary: Sánchez's own despatch of 16 August 1523, not calendared: he refers the Emperor to the joint letter with Caracciolo, says something French-leaning in Venice can do little harm, and that the capitulation says nothing of the Venetian money; the clear postscript explains why the Infante was not bound to the defensive league.
texts.note: The reading resolves the code groups; the spelled runs are only partly read. No separate transcription of the ciphertext.

texts.label: R9769, 16 Aug 1523
texts.summary: Caracciolo and Sánchez to Charles V, 16 August 1523, nearly all in clear: the league concluded, Pace left for Ferrara and Milan, the Infante's envoy, prisoners freed.
texts.note: Read at sight for the record table; neither the clear text nor the short cipher was transcribed (project work).

texts.label: R9770, 16 Aug 1523
texts.summary: Duplicate of R9769 (joint letter of 16 August 1523), with a short cipher at the head of the last page and a clear note on the "mutua restitucion" instrument.
texts.note: Read at sight for the record table; neither the clear text nor the short cipher was transcribed (project work).
